name: upload_inline_to_endpoint
description: Plan A end-to-end smoke graph. An inline-uploaded document is forwarded to a KB endpoint via http_request multipart using $attachment:<document_id>. Used by tests/attachment_uniform_resolution_test.rs (the test rewrites url to point at a wiremock server at runtime).

config.system_prompt: You are an upload agent. The user attaches a document. Use the http_upload tool to POST it to the configured endpoint as multipart/form-data. The body MUST be {"file": "$attachment:<document_id>"} where <document_id> is the doc the user provided (see the catalog block in this message). Do not invent placeholders.

http_upload.description: Upload a file as multipart to the KB endpoint.

body.description: Must be { "file": "$attachment:<document_id>" } where <document_id> comes from the catalog.
